accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:qv-growth and Theorem 3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The predictable-QV lower envelope is assumed, not derived from the residual-marginal transport construction.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform conservative coverage conditional on V_n ≥ v_0 s_n² over the stated common-parameter class; this is a regularity regime restriction, not a claimed sharpness result.
